Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished art-direction contact board for Acornaut, a painterly illustrated space game. This is a foreground PLANET AND DEBRIS FAMILY STUDY, not a background scene and not production sprites. The supplied contact sheets are STYLE references only. Do not edit or reproduce their layout. Make a landscape board with 4 clearly separated horizontal rows on a plain dark navy neutral presentation field. Each row has exactly FIVE separate round solid planets across the first five evenly spaced columns, plus the listed TWO or THREE much smaller debris shapes grouped at the far right. Each row is a distinct zone; include only the short numbered zone heading above that row. No individual object text. Large clean detailed painterly assets, directional upper-left light, realistic tactile materials like the references, no characters, no gameplay UI, no scenery, no stars, no ground shadows. Planets have coherent circular solid cores; keep rings slender. Show diverse surface structures within each row, not five recolors. Do not add extra planets or reuse a planet across rows. All five should be visibly distinct. Existing-asset entries are only illustrative reinterpretations in this concept board; source images will be shown separately in the review.

ROW 01 DEEP SPACE: Familiar astronomical frontier. Palette: blue oceans / ochre gas / ivory regolith. Five planets left-to-right: 1. blue-green Earth with clouds; 2. ochre banded Saturn with a slim gold ring; 3. pale silver cratered moon; 4. ochre and cream gas bands with one broad oval storm; 5. matte dusty red plains and a single long canyon. SMALL DEBRIS: Lost Antenna, Nickel Fragment.

ROW 02 NEBULA NURSERY: Worlds still forming. Palette: teal / dusty rose / pale lilac. Five planets left-to-right: 1. teal banded gas giant with a slim teal ring; 2. dusty rose cratered moon; 3. plum and cream softly folded cloud layers; 4. pale compact sphere with a dark curved shell seam; 5. lavender solid globe with a short dusty equatorial belt. SMALL DEBRIS: Rose Seed Crystal, rounded plum stone enclosing cloudy pale inclusions.

ROW 03 ICE MOON: A frozen expedition. Palette: cobalt / frost white / slate. Five planets left-to-right: 1. cyan-white ice-crust globe; 2. blue-black ocean split by thick white glacier shelves; 3. charcoal cratered moon dusted with rim frost; 4. deep cobalt sphere with pale circular frozen lakes; 5. slate gas world with broad white frozen storm bands. SMALL DEBRIS: Blue Ice Chunk, dark angular rock with thick white frost on one face.

ROW 04 SOLAR FURNACE: Solid worlds forged by heat. Palette: charcoal / copper / ember orange. Five planets left-to-right: 1. charcoal magma globe with orange seams; 2. oxidized iron globe with sparse hot pits; 3. matte charcoal cratered sphere with ash-white rims; 4. blue-black glassy globe with dull copper scabs; 5. dark basalt planet with three broad glowing vent basins. SMALL DEBRIS: Magma Boulder, Ember Plate.

ROW 05 SAPPHIRE ABYSS: Deep ocean without a shoreline. Palette: midnight blue / indigo / silver foam. Five planets left-to-right: 1. indigo ocean cut by one silver-lit abyssal fault; 2. navy planet crossed by broad curved pale tidal bands; 3. near-black blue globe with sparse bioluminescent pinpricks; 4. dark sapphire gas-sea globe with a dense white storm cap; 5. dark mineral seabed sphere with compact blue ridges and pale edge light. SMALL DEBRIS: rounded dense navy stone with a silver fracture, thick smoky blue fragment with a pale beveled edge.

ROW 06 CRYSTAL BELT: An exposed mineral belt. Palette: cyan / quartz white / amethyst. Five planets left-to-right: 1. round cyan crystal-studded world; 2. round purple amethyst crystal world; 3. rounded dark globe studded with broad milky quartz plates; 4. round smoky mineral shell with one pale open geode face; 5. spherical mineral mass built from short flat lavender crystal plates. SMALL DEBRIS: Quartz Cluster, Amethyst Shard, Cyan Cluster.

ROW 07 CRIMSON STORM: Atmospheric violence. Palette: burgundy / scarlet / storm grey. Five planets left-to-right: 1. red globe with sweeping cyclonic clouds; 2. scarlet gas world with broad storm bands and a dark pole; 3. rust-red cloud planet with slate thunderheads; 4. pale grey atmosphere with one large dark-red storm eye; 5. near-black globe with sweeping burgundy cloud streaks. SMALL DEBRIS: dark red metallic shard with a bright cut face, smoky red angular glass enclosing pale streaks.

ROW 08 VIOLET REALM: Quiet violet celestial worlds. Palette: violet / plum / lavender / ivory. Five planets left-to-right: 1. purple gas globe with broad pale swirls; 2. dark violet solid world with one thin violet ring; 3. muted lavender sand globe with large wind-carved ridges; 4. deep plum solid world with thick ivory mineral veins; 5. smooth dark violet cratered globe with a restrained lavender rim. SMALL DEBRIS: compact dark plum rock with a pale broken face, rounded lavender stone with broad ivory veins.

ROW 09 MONOCHROME VOID: Color disappears; texture remains. Palette: ivory / neutral grey / graphite. Five planets left-to-right: 1. neutral grey cratered moon; 2. off-white sphere with bold graphite fissures; 3. dark grey gas world with broad silver bands; 4. brushed silver globe with hammered dark impact patches; 5. neutral grey planet divided by one sweeping pale geological basin. SMALL DEBRIS: Crater Rock, Regolith Slab.

ROW 10 HYPERVIVID: Liquid color and pigment. Palette: magenta / cyan / yellow / midnight. Five planets left-to-right: 1. smooth multicolor ribbon-marbled globe; 2. deep blue planet with broad colored pigment continents; 3. teal sphere with smooth broad pink iridescent pools; 4. magenta and midnight gas globe with large curved turquoise streaks; 5. cream pearl planet marbled with separated cyan and violet ink blooms. SMALL DEBRIS: Colorglass, curved glossy cyan fragment with a magenta underside.

ROW 11 RUST BELT: An abandoned orbital foundry. Palette: rust / gunmetal / verdigris. Five planets left-to-right: 1. rust orange spherical metal world with rivets; 2. round rusty world covered in broad iron plates; 3. weathered copper sphere with large teal oxidized panels; 4. grey iron globe with recessed circular fasteners and wide seams; 5. solid round furnace shell with one dark recessed cast-metal basin. SMALL DEBRIS: Rust Sheet, Machine Wreck, compact rusted gear section with a pale worn edge.

ROW 12 BONE DESERT: Fossils and dry sediment. Palette: chalk / sand / umber. Five planets left-to-right: 1. ochre sandstone globe with deep broad dunes; 2. pale cracked chalk-shell world; 3. umber sediment globe with broad ivory fossil-like bands; 4. pale round weathered limestone world with dark large pores; 5. dark brown globe carved by wide tan eroded channels. SMALL DEBRIS: Chalk Fragment, short ivory sediment slab showing a curved fossil impression.

ROW 13 GOLDEN HOUR: Amber light trapped in worlds. Palette: honey / bronze / amber / deep brown. Five planets left-to-right: 1. translucent-looking honey shell over a clearly solid dark round core; 2. bronze solid world with one thin pale gold dusty belt; 3. dark ochre globe with silky bronze dune ridges; 4. round umber sphere carrying broad honey-gold cellular plates; 5. dark brown gas giant with subdued amber horizontal bands. SMALL DEBRIS: Gold Ore, Honeycomb Fragment.

ROW 14 SOLAR CORONA: Sun-scorched surfaces. Palette: porcelain / carbon / copper light. Five planets left-to-right: 1. ivory solar-baked globe with three broad carbon-dark basins; 2. porcelain sphere with dark cracks and a narrow copper-lit edge; 3. solid burnished copper globe with a single dark curved reflection band; 4. charcoal gas sphere with widely spaced pale-gold thermal bands; 5. dark burgundy rocky planet with one pale sun-scorched hemisphere. SMALL DEBRIS: dark baked rock with pale scorched crust, compact copper-colored metal flake with a white-hot-looking painted edge.

ROW 15 CORAL SHALLOWS: Living shallow-water worlds. Palette: coral pink / lagoon teal / pearl. Five planets left-to-right: 1. teal ocean globe with dense peach coral islands; 2. pink globe with dense rounded reef lobes; 3. teal round ocean world ringed by irregular pale shell islands; 4. pearl-grey globe with broad deep-teal channels and small coral ridges; 5. dark teal world with distinct peach reef crescents and shallow mint pools. SMALL DEBRIS: short dense peach coral branch with a dark broken base, pearly curved shell fragment with a teal edge.

ROW 16 EMERALD EXPANSE: Ordered green geology. Palette: jade / teal / pale stone / plum edge. Five planets left-to-right: 1. pale jade sphere with large stepped mineral terraces; 2. green stone globe with ivory veins and a restrained plum edge; 3. teal planet with broad pale branching river deltas; 4. dark olive sphere with cream cloud islands; 5. ivory rocky globe with large flat emerald continental patches. SMALL DEBRIS: pale jade slab with a dark fractured edge, rounded ivory and teal sediment stone.

ROW 17 ALIEN JUNGLE: Dense and strange living worlds. Palette: forest green / bark / lilac spores. Five planets left-to-right: 1. round densely forested green world; 2. round brown seed-like planet with a large amber eye; 3. lilac globe with small pale alien flowers; 4. dark round bark world wrapped in broad pale roots; 5. rounded mossy world with compact cream and lilac fungal caps. SMALL DEBRIS: Overgrown Rock, compact tangled woody fragment with moss on one side.

ROW 18 ACID SWAMP: Chemical pools and unstable crust. Palette: sulfur / tar / petrol blue / pale salt. Five planets left-to-right: 1. yellow-green salt plates over a dark slate sphere; 2. round near-black world with large smooth olive bubble basins; 3. pale sulfur globe with thick dark cracks and no neon bloom; 4. dark blue-green sphere with contained iridescent oily pools; 5. slate round world divided by broad chartreuse channels and pale salt rims. SMALL DEBRIS: Sulfur Ore, dark compact glossy fragment with a pale sulfur deposit.

ROW 19 AURORA CROWN: Polar light on solid worlds. Palette: teal / icy lavender / deep blue. Five planets left-to-right: 1. dark blue globe with mint aurora on its surface and a slender lavender ring; 2. dark blue world with sweeping green surface-light bands; 3. dark blue globe with a broad pale-violet polar curtain painted across its surface; 4. slate sphere with restrained mint bands and an icy cap; 5. deep teal world with a large reflective lavender polar basin. SMALL DEBRIS: Aurora Shard, compact icy slate shard with a thin teal iridescent face.

ROW 20 PULSAR FIELD: Charged magnetic worlds. Palette: navy / ice white / muted electric cyan. Five planets left-to-right: 1. dark navy world with thin pale electric-crack lines; 2. dark cobalt sphere with thin pale meridian seams; 3. ivory planet with large dark navy polar plates; 4. burgundy-black sphere with broad static cyan magnetic bands; 5. dark iron globe with one sharply defined pale equatorial seam. SMALL DEBRIS: Charged Sapphire, Broken Receiver, dense navy fragment crossed by one pale cyan seam.
